name: ModelVariant768_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant768_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (four model parts leave fading quad trails, then sparks fan out from the burst centre under a flash quad and a pulsing ring, two shrinking columns of textured quads drift sideways and, once they pass the slot, dots fall and a textured ring grows); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, clears the four 32-point trails, builds the ring points from the slot dimensions and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the delay, 1 once when the burst ends and again after the report start, 2 once the burst has faded or the end time has passed and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-785 and 882 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
